definitions.gloss: central pillar of a traditional Japanese house
definitions.explanation: The main structural pillar in a traditional Japanese building, typically the thickest and strongest column supporting the entire structure.
Figuratively, the person who is the main support of a family, organization, or team. The one everyone depends on.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれていた→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。

examples.english: She has been active for many years as the mainstay of this company.

notes: Named after {大黒天|だいこくてん} (Daikokuten), the god of wealth and prosperity. In traditional Japanese houses, the {大黒柱|だいこくばしら} was positioned near the center of the home and was both structurally and symbolically important. The figurative sense (breadwinner, mainstay) is more common in everyday conversation. Collocations: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大黒柱|だいこくばしら} (family breadwinner), ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大黒柱|だいこくばしら} (team's key player), {大黒柱|だいこくばしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose one's mainstay).
